[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

[[Category:Oak Grove Cemetery, Lexington, Virginia]]
== Biography ==
John was born in 1785. He was the son of [[Glasgow-649|Arthur Glasgow]] and [[McNutt-600|Rebecca McNutt]].  He passed away in 1830.

An agreement dated 19 September 1822 concerning Arthur Glasgow's estate names John among Arthur's participating children and devisees, directly establishing the father-son relationship.<ref name="ArthurEstate1822">Arthur Glasgow estate agreement, 19 September 1822; [https://old.lva.virginia.gov/ChanceryImg/163-Rockbridge/BOX%20016/163_1833_005_0089.pdf Library of Virginia image].</ref>
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-649]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The 1822 Arthur Glasgow estate agreement names John among Arthur’s children and devisees. The family history identifies the same John born 27 December 1785 with Arthur and Rebecca McNutt.

The estate supports Arthur’s paternity directly; it does not alone prove every maternal detail.

Next useful test: Compare signatures and residence if another John is proposed.

Source basis already held: [https://old.lva.virginia.gov/ChanceryImg/163-Rockbridge/BOX%20016/163_1833_005_0089.pdf Arthur Glasgow estate agreement, 19 September 1822; Library of Virginia image (https://old.lva.virginia.gov/ChanceryImg/163-Rockbridge/BOX%20016/163_1833_005_0089.pdf).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
